ADVISORY COMMISSION ON AGING AGENDA

  2028 Olympic and Paralympics Games Planning.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-56051  Recommendation to receive and file Superintendent’s Update on department
  business.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.
